I replied in the #north-team thread to Ilse's message: "Thanks, Ilse. Noted: 261 seats for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal. No action taken."

I treated the seat count as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat it in the channel. I didn't write it to the gbrain knowledge brain, since she asked for it "for your records" rather than explicitly asking me to store it.
